name: Crude and vacuum distillation with heat integration
applications: first separation step in every refinery
principle: Crude is desalted, preheated against hot product streams and heated in a fired furnace, then separated by boiling range in an atmospheric column into gas, naphtha, kerosene, diesel and atmospheric residue. The residue would crack and foul at atmospheric pressure, so it is reheated and split again under vacuum into vacuum gas oils and vacuum residue.

process_steps.name: Atmospheric distillation
equipment: atmospheric column with side strippers and pumparounds

process_steps.name: Vacuum residue to coker, resid upgrading or fuel oil
